images.generationPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create exactly ONE photorealistic Chinese home-menu food photograph, landscape 4:3. Unified series styling: camera about 45 degrees above the table, one centered unbranded ivory ceramic serving vessel with its complete rim visible, dish occupies about 75% of the frame with a little breathing room; pale light-oak wooden tabletop; soft natural window light; appetizing realistic food textures, true ingredient colors, fresh modest green garnish. No people, hands, utensils, extra dishes, table clutter, collage, panels, typography, titles, captions, numbers, badges, labels, watermarks, signatures or logos anywhere. Keep the entire dish in focus. Subject: Hakka clear pork soup, 客家土猪汤. One centered ivory ceramic soup bowl, with a complete visible rim, filled with clear lightly golden pork broth. Several generous irregular thin slices and small tender chunks of fully cooked lean pork visibly suspended near the surface; subtle natural oil droplets; just a few chopped green scallions. Pure pork and water style, no bones, organs, noodles, mushrooms, vegetables, seafood, heavy spices or creamy broth. The pork pieces must be visibly cooked, not pink raw meat. Comforting simple homemade clear meat soup.
